sloka: अलं त्रासेन सुग्रीव बाष्पवेगो निगृह्यताम् ।एवं प्रायाणि युद्धानि विजयो नास्ति नैष्ठिकः ।। ६.४६.३२ ।।।।
transliteration: alaṁ trāsena sugrīva bāṣpavego nigṛhyatām ।evaṁ prāyāṇi yuddhāni vijayo nāsti naiṣṭhikaḥ ।। 6.46.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Sugriva was overtaken by fear on seeing Rama and Lakshmana riddled with arrows from head to foot all over the body
